audit_limitations: Hypersensitivity exclusions list doxorubicin/cyclophosphamide/paclitaxel but omit naming trastuzumab; trastuzumab adverse-event table still explicitly stops for grade4 hypersensitivity. Do not imply trastuzumab hypersensitivity is safe.

Routine full-dose platelets threshold is>100 but low-platelet row<100 and ANC-low row>=100. Exactly100 with ANC>=1 is not covered by routine rows; recovery text differs. Explicit boundary review is needed.
Doxorubicin integer-labelled20–50 and51–86 bands leave continuous-value gap50<bilirubin<51; use explicit review/rounding-policy confirmation. No AST reduction is printed in this updated table.
CrCl10–29 and>=30 integer-labelled bands leave29<CrCl<30 undefined for continuous values; confirm clinical rounding/band interpretation instead of silently treating as normal.

Paclitaxel bilirubin bands leave1.25<ratio<1.26 and2<ratio<2.01 gaps. Both ALT and bilirubin are needed for a numerical hepatic dose; either high exclusion alone remains actionable. Missing ALT must not infer ALT<10.
Trastuzumab LVEFhold table omits currentLVEF<50% requirement found in00432/00433/00745/SmPC. Preserve and label this stricter00316source exception; do not silently harmonise.
Educational / software source reconciliation is not consultant, pharmacy or clinical-use authorisation.

source_monitoring.blood_repeat: FBC/renal/liver profile prior to each cycle
source_monitoring.baseline_echo: Not listed in baseline subsection (only bloods/ECG); cardiac eligibility and on-treatment cardiac monitoring still apply; use separately attributed SmPC for baseline HER2 cardiac assessment
source_monitoring.repeat_echo: MUGA/ECHO every12weeks; if cardiac impairment signs, checks every4–8weeks may be more appropriate
source_monitoring.disease_monitoring: Treatment-plan/consultant-directed; no fixed CT/marker schedule stated
source_monitoring.echo_cycle_mapping: Illustrative elapsed-time mapping only:12weeks corresponds to12 weekly trastuzumab intervals (next weekly dose13),4 q21d intervals (next q21d dose5),or6 q14d intervals. If trastuzumab starts at overallcycle5, count from documented baseline/pre-HER2 checkpoint; never reset the due date silently at phase transition.

metadata.schedule_summary: Four AC cycles every 14 days, then four fortnightly paclitaxel treatments with trastuzumab weekly on Days 1 and 8 of each 14-day block (eight weekly antibody doses). Trastuzumab then continues every 21 days to complete one year total; it is not given with AC.
